title: 1 Queen vs 1 Impostor
summary: Among Us theme vs Fairy-Stockfish: Tony's queen is replaced by an Impostor that moves like a queen but, as its move, can also teleport ('vent') to a secret vent square Tony chose on his own half of the board (he picks g4). Stockfish doesn't know where the vent is, so pieces landing on g4 get eaten. He wins material early but eventually loses to a rook sac and Bc3# (~12:56) with the impostor stranded on h7.
rules: Player's queen replaced by the Impostor: moves/captures like a queen.
Before the game the player secretly chooses one vent square on their own half (ranks 1-4).
As a full turn, the Impostor may teleport from anywhere to the vent square (capturing any enemy piece there). Venting costs a move.
Opponent does not know the vent location (hidden information).
